criteria.bundle_handle: test::evidence_open mints an opaque bundle handle; test::evidence_append adds named byte blobs; test::evidence_seal freezes the bundle and returns digests plus a closed-vocabulary receipt kind. The bundle content is exactly what was appended; nothing outside the append calls can enter the sealed digest.
criteria.memory_only: Add no persist operations; evidence stays in Can values and the caller persists them. Zero new mechanism, but no owner-visible sealed artifact and no uniform receipt vocabulary.
criteria.path_seal: Tests write evidence with files::* anywhere, then test::evidence_seal takes a str[] of paths and returns digests plus a receipt kind. Reuses files::* with one new op, but the seal input is unconstrained paths: missing, swapped or out-of-scope files are readable at seal time.

evidence_bundle.instructions: Which evidence shape produces digested, sealed receipts (qualified-report, n-receipt, cleanup-receipt) with the least mechanism?

criteria.grant_wrapped_reuse: Reuse process::run unchanged (arbitrary executable string) behind a grant check: test::grant_process authorizes one process::run call per grant. Least new mechanism, but any authorized call can still name any executable, so arbitrary dispatch remains expressible inside the grant.
criteria.keyed_dispatch: test::run_tool takes an owner-registered tool key plus argv/cwd/env/options, never a path. The N owner registers each staged tool (bundled bun, formatter, built CLI) against the grant before the run; unknown or unregistered keys reject before spawn. Dispatch vocabulary is closed per run; workspace-relative staging stays inside the registered tool records.
criteria.workspace_relative: test::process_run takes a workspace handle plus a relative executable path with argv/cwd/env/options. Absolute paths and parent-escaping (../) segments reject; everything spawned must live under the sealed workspace root. The workspace handle, not a registry, is the confinement boundary.

process_dispatch.instructions: Which process-dispatch shape keeps arbitrary dispatch/eval unrepresentable while still expressing staged offline tool runs with cwd/env/argv/limits and descendant cleanup?

criteria.no_workspace_ops: Add no workspace operations; tests pass raw paths to files::* directly and manage staging/cleanup by convention. Zero new mechanism, zero confinement, and no owner-visible cleanup receipt.
criteria.opaque_handle: test::workspace_open mints an opaque non-constructible workspace handle bound to a fresh owner-scoped directory; new test::* file operations take the handle plus a relative path; test::workspace_close seals and schedules cleanup. Forged handles fail table lookup, stale handles fail liveness, absolute/escaping paths reject. Mirrors the grant/channel handle discipline.
criteria.root_path_string: test::workspace_root returns the fresh directory as a plain str path and tests reuse the existing files::* operations with joined paths. Smallest new surface (one op), but confinement is by convention: nothing stops a test from passing any other path to files::*.

workspace_model.instructions: Which workspace shape gives tests isolated, cleanable scratch directories with the least mechanism and no ambient file access?
